verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents a local development runner and Pipecat Evals, but neither is an isolated sandbox. The runner runs the agent on the developer's machine and is explicitly 'not a sandbox'. Evals run 'against your real agent (the same pipeline, the same services, the same code)', and no hosted Pipecat Cloud sandbox or test mode isolated from production data is documented. The OpenAPI spec's mention of running mocks is only a developer building block, not a product-provided sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
